data.case_title: New employer document request before start of employment
data.title: Onboarding letter: documents required before your first payroll
data.summary: Beispiel Software Solutions GmbH welcomes Aisha Okafor, whose first working day is 1 July 2025, and asks her to upload her tax ID, health insurance certificate and residence permit copy to the HR portal by 6 June 2025 so payroll and social security registration can be processed on time.
data.explanation: Your new employer needs three documents — your tax identification number, your health insurance membership certificate and a copy of your residence permit — uploaded to their HR portal by the stated date. If you miss it, they say they cannot register you for social security on time, which could delay your first payroll. Gather these documents now (your health insurer can issue the membership certificate, and your Steuer-ID was sent to you by the Bundeszentralamt für Steuern) and upload them via the HR portal well before the deadline.

key_facts.quote: Please upload your tax identification number (Steuer-ID), your health insurance membership certificate and a copy of your residence permit to the HR portal no later than 6 June 2025.
